reviewer: mock_portal_audit (independent of SL content author and PDF builder)
scope: Final combined PDFs for the four Mathematics AA SL mocks: reconstructed question paper followed by the corrected supplied worked solution book.

method.scientificReview: All 40 original native solution pages, all question stems and all marking points were independently read and recalculated before this PDF layout review; see sl-independent-review.json and its 238 executable evidence checks.
method.finalRenderReview: All final pages were inspected in contact sheets. Every new question page and every source page containing a correction were additionally inspected at native render size. A2 was rebuilt after the orphan end-marker finding; its current contact sheets, last question page, solution cover and both corrected solution pages were re-inspected. A2 question content is unchanged; earlier native content review and current contact review both apply.
method.programmaticChecks: The actual PDF bytes were hashed and compared to pdf-checks.json. All 88 pages were checked for branding, consecutive final page numbering and removed source/file strings. Page counts, question-start pages, solution boundary, cover duration, marks, calculator instruction and branded metadata passed.
method.renderLocation: work/aa-mocks-2026/pdf-review/<paper-id>/page-NNN.png and contact-XX.png (task workspace, outside the repository)
method.staleRenderExcluded: The old A2 page-023.png is a stale render from the pre-fix 23-page PDF and was excluded. The final A2 PDF contains 22 pages.

commonChecks.calculatorInstructions: Paper 1: calculator not permitted; Paper 2: graphic display calculator required.
